info.description: One picture, with the words that go with it.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot. The `url` field is hidden by default and shown again by `metadatas_outside_production`, which is merged over `metadatas` only when NODE_ENV is not "production": the field exists for the seed script, which fills it so that a fresh clone needs no uploads, and an editor has the file field beside it and never wants this one.

edit.label: URL
edit.description: An address to load the picture from instead of uploading one. The seed script uses this; an editor should use the file above.

edit.label: Title
edit.description: Shown beneath the picture, where the design shows a caption.

edit.label: Caption
edit.description: A second, smaller line beneath the title.

edit.label: Alternative text
edit.description: What the picture shows, for a visitor who cannot see it. Leave it empty when the picture is decoration.
